independent_state_labels.conclusion: Allowed metadata has no cell-cycle phase / independent lineage / pre-treatment state label. ncounts/ngenes are not independent state labels; does not assert such labels cannot exist elsewhere.

guide_identity.conclusion: guide_id is recorded, including paired-guide identifiers. Identity/coordinate strings permit grouping but do not verify on-target efficacy or specificity.

measured_knockdown.conclusion: No efficacy/knockdown/protein measurement field in inspected metadata. Presence of a target transcript among genes is not measured target-specific knockdown.

smn_specificity.conclusion: Guide target label and positional identifiers do not establish SMN2-versus-SMN1 specificity. No sequence/off-target validation, rescue or SMN protein data in these inspected sources.
